changes: New: CALL & RESPONSE, a call phrase on one audio track and its answer on another (SRC SETUP, like VECTOR).
The call track sets the motif, density, repetition, scale and layout; the answer track picks one of 31 answer strategies, an ending, tightness, mutation and transposition.
Writes real trigs with PTCH locks (VOL on accents); the sequencer plays them. YES draws a new call or a new answer.
Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta). Card firmware cannot include it.
Not yet tested on a unit or in the emulator.
